articles.summary: We asked 53 independent grocery operators where AI should help their stores. They named promotions, reporting, and pricing. Most still aren't using it.
articles.title: AI in grocery: 70% are planning for it, 13% are using it

articles.title: Introducing Chip: the virtual employee built for independent grocers
